༄༅/ /rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs bde chen 'bar byed bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs bde chen 'bar byed bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra yo gi ni bh+yaḥ rmad byung mchog tu ngo mtshar ba'i/ /rdo rje btsun mo sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rnyed pa 'di yang skal bzang ste/ /lha mos rjes su gnang bar mdzod/ /sgrub thabs kyi dmigs pa rnams spyi dang mthun par sgoms shing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ gang gi drin gyi sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyi phyag batshal/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ hūm̐ḥsum+bha lan gnyis/ oṃ gha gha sogs/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra sogs/ oṃ me dhi ni nas/ lar ka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gi bar sngags tshan drug brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ gsum rnams las/ chos 'byung 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du / bh+rum̐ las gzhal med khang*/ phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba nang shar dkar/ lha ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ dbus sum pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad dang sgo mtshams rnams su nyi ma'i gdan ra ེ / dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma/ sgo bzhir mi ro'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de'i bar du bam̐ las rdo rje bam̐ gyi mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje phag mo ban+dhu ka dang sin+dhu ra'i mdog can/ nyi ma bcu gnyis kyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa ltar na/ dmar ljang sngo ba'i zhal lam yang na/ zhal gsum ka yang dmar ba/ phyag drug g-i dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas thabs he ru ka dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyi mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ tha ma gnyis kyi g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/

yang na rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po dang ljang khu/ g.yon la sngon po dang ser po/ steng gi zhal nag gdong dmar po/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdor dril/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi glang lpags/ g.yas lhag mas ḍā ma ru/ dgra sta gri gug /rtse gsum g.yon lhag mas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /thod pa/ zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams 'dzin par byas kyang rung ngo*/ / zhabs sems pa'i dkyil mo dkrung gi bzhugs so/ /dbu skra phyed bcings zhing phyed grol ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ rin po che dang me tog la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyi rnam par brgyan pa/ spyan gsum mche rtsigs/ drag mo'i tshul can bde ba rgyas pa mo/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du rdo rje gsang ba mchog ma/ byang du rdo rje dam tshig mchog ma/ nub tu rdo rje gzi brjid mchog ma/ lhor rdo rje rin chen mchog ma/ mer rdo rje ye shes mchog ma/ bden bral du rdo rje rig mchog ma/ rlung du rdo rje grub mchog ma/ dbang gdan du rdo rje thal ba mchog ma/ thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal gsum ka'ang dmar zhing*/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang gi thabs la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis kyi thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams gtso mo nyid dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje 'bar ba mchog ma/ byang sgor rdo rje bdud rtsi mchog ma/ nub sgor rdo rje khro bo mchog ma/ lho sgor rdo rje mche ba mchog ma rnams 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams dang 'dra ba las/ rdo rje sor zhing zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzug rkyang ba/ g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs shing cher khrol pa'o/ /gra bzhir lha mo mda' gzhu 'gengs pa dkar ser/ dmar ljang ba/ las kyi pho nya mo'i tshul du gnas par gyur/ rang gi thugs khar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems pa/

de'i thugs khar ting nge 'dzin sems pa bam̐/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs khar hūm̐/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo sogs go chas brgyas btab/ phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ slar yang dbang gi lha rnams phaiṃ/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa abhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ gtso mo la rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor rnams la he ru ka phyag gnyis pa rnams kyi dbu brgyan/ de nas spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gtso bor gsal btab ste/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bā rā hi ā bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra gu h+ya ud+ta me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra sa ma ya ud ta me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra te dzod ta me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra rat+nod maṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dzñā nod ta me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bir+yā ud ta me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra sidhod+ta me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bhasmot+ta me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra āḥ dzā lot+ta me dz+dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra a mṛ tod ta me hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kro dhod ta me bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra daṃṣ+t+rod ta me ho hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ thun bsdu ba'i sngon du ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa/ rnams byas la/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi 'od zer gyi/ snaud bcud thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang*/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying khar bsdu/ go chas rgyas btab la/ dag pa gsum dran bzhin pas mthun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go/ gtor ma'i cho ga n-i/ sdom 'byung bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/

/ gsang ba byin dang mchog gyur pa/ /ye shes grags pa grol mchog zhabs/ /bla ma mchog ni zhal las 'ongs/ /rgyud rdo rje'i dngos stan zab mo'i gnad/ /'jigs bral nyid kyi khyad par chos/ /srog 'dzin gdams pa'i smin byed kyi/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni 'di kho na/ /deng dus de y-i srol 'dzin du// grags shing rlom pa rnams kyis ni/ /gang 'di'i ming yang mi shes te/ kho bo'i bsod nams skal bas thob/ /ces pa mngon brjod le'u gsum bcu rtsa drug pa las 'byung ba/ mchog gi rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ bde chen 'bar byed ces pa stai mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal gzigs kyi mthil/ shin tu gsang bar gyur pa 'di ni/ bsod nams mchog gyur pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs rgyas pa las/ snying po mtha' dag bsdus ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu pa la chos grwa gser mdog can du sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs bde chen 'bar byed bzhugs/ - PAGE 398 -- PAGE 397 -- PAGE 396 -
